name: FI Boo
reason: Two solution families fit TESS equally well: shallow (f 0.15-0.21, i 35-37.5 deg) and deep (f 0.6-0.9, i 30-33 deg). With the radial-velocity mass function (M1+M2) sin^3 i = 0.343 Msun the deep family implies 2.1-2.7 Msun and 3.2-4.4 Lsun; Gaia DR3 (parallax 8.280 mas, G 9.383) gives 1.9-2.15 Lsun. The deep family is excluded.
